acceptance_criteria.source: "Review this PR and please, why do we need +1.8k new lines for this?"
acceptance_criteria.text: The review explains where the PR's ~1.8k added lines come from (which parts of the diff account for the volume).
The review gives a clear opinion on whether the PR is overengineered, with reasons grounded in the PR's content.

acceptance_criteria.source: "check the test for redundancy, or uneeded testing"
acceptance_criteria.text: The test audit names specific tests or subtests in the PR's test files that are redundant or unneeded, with a reason for each.

acceptance_criteria.source: User answered "y" to the assistant's "Want me to make the cuts?", approving the audit's list presented before turn 2.
acceptance_criteria.text: Every test the audit presented before turn 2 identified as redundant or unneeded is removed in the final diff, or reported as kept with a reason.

acceptance_criteria.source: The user declined to split the PR and asked only to audit the tests for redundancy, so the change is scoped to tests and production code must be untouched.
acceptance_criteria.text: Only test files (*_test.go) are modified; no production code changes are made.

acceptance_criteria.source: Removing tests as redundant implies the same properties are still proven elsewhere; cutting coverage outright would break something the user did not ask to lose.
acceptance_criteria.text: Behaviors whose tests were removed remain covered by other retained or added tests, so no behavior is left entirely untested by the cuts.

acceptance_criteria.source: CLAUDE.md: Development → Running Tests `mise run test`; Tech Stack → Linting: golangci-lint.
acceptance_criteria.text: The repository's checks pass: go build ./..., go test for cmd/entire/cli (mise run test), and golangci-lint run.
After 'ship it', the test cleanup is committed and pushed to the PR branch when the remote is reachable; otherwise the commit is made and the inability to push is reported.

analysis.completion_evidence: Turn-0 review explained the line count as 4 features bundled plus ~1100 test lines. Turn-1 audit named specific redundant subtests. Final diff shows removal of ~180 lines of subtests in repo_mirror_test.go and repo_test.go and +93 lines of unit tests in corecmd_test.go (TestFetchPagesBounded, TestValidatePageSize, TestPageModeRequested); no production files touched. Test runs: BUILD OK, `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/` ok, golangci-lint 0 issues. Final assistant text says 'Pushed' with commit 17f321584 and proposes a PR comment.
analysis.notes: The addition of unit tests in corecmd_test.go was the assistant's proposal accepted via 'y'; c5 is phrased as 'coverage not lost' rather than mandating those specific tests. The final assistant turn asks whether to post a PR comment; no user response, so posting the comment is not a criterion. Diff source is linked_commit and may include edits outside the session, but it matches the assistant's described changes.
analysis.task_statement: The user asked for a review of a PR (in the Entire CLI repo) questioning why it added ~1.8k lines and whether it was overengineered. After the review, the user declined to split the PR and instead asked for an audit of the tests for redundancy/unneeded testing, then approved making the cuts, and finally asked to ship (commit/push) the resulting test-only cleanup.

turn_script.intent: Do not split the PR; instead audit the PR's tests for redundancy and unneeded testing.
turn_script.skip_if: Never; this redirects the work after the initial review.
turn_script.trigger: The replay has delivered its PR review (whether or not it suggests splitting or asks what to do next).
turn_script.voice: I don't want to split it, check the test for redundancy, or uneeded testing/

turn_script.intent: Approve going ahead and making the test cuts identified in the audit.
turn_script.skip_if: The replay already made the cuts without asking.
turn_script.trigger: The replay has presented its redundancy findings and asks or pauses before editing.

turn_script.intent: Commit and push the test cleanup to the PR branch.
turn_script.skip_if: The replay already committed and pushed the changes.
turn_script.trigger: The replay reports the test cuts are done with tests passing.
